sources.title: Embassy of Panama: immigration and visas
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Panamanian Government embassy immigration page publishes a named no-visa visitor-country list and includes Chile, separately from conditional third-country visa or residence routes.
sources.supportingExcerpt: No Visa Required: if you are from any of the following countries ... Chile.

policies.title: Chilean ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's current embassy immigration guidance names Chile in its no-visa visitor-country list for stays of up to three months.
conditions: Ordinary Chilean passport and short visitor travel for no more than three months; carry the stated passport validity, return/onward travel and funds where requested.
Work, residence, transit, conditional third-country-document routes and final admission remain separate.

South Sudan's current MFA country table says a visa is needed but does not establish whether an ordinary Chilean visitor receives eVisa, visa on arrival, or an advance visa. The portal is not a nationality decision.
